description: OCCURS DYNAMIC — a dynamic-capacity table (§2023:13.18.38 Format 4 / §2023:8.5.1.9), ISO 2014+; below 2014 the OCCURS DYNAMIC clause is COBOL0900. The growable CobolDynTable<T> substrate (data-model D9); the CAPACITY register, SET Format 14, SEARCH over the current capacity, and the variable-length-group operations are greenfield-corpus goldens, not matrix rows.
citation: ISO §2023:13.18.38 Format 4 / §2023:8.5.1.9; CAPACITY register + SET Format 14 + SEARCH over current capacity
